## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Contractor's shall make use of 'tool box' training to create and maintain high levels of H&S awareness, transfer information, advise personnel of changing circumstances and work progress and participate in site-wide campaigns. Such talks will be held in a conducive environment, with a brief opportunity for questions and discussion, shall be conducted every week, and records kept of topics and personnel attendance. Note: Tool Box Talks will form only part of the Contractors overall training program, the contractor should submit a Competency matrix which covers all levels of their respective organizations.
- > The competence of individuals engaged in high risk activities such as working at height, confined space entry, electrical, crane operations, etc. will be of particular interest to Emaar Misr and it is the responsibility of the Contractor to ensure that only competent people/organizations are engaged in thesetasks.
- 企 Emaar Misr will pcrforn periudic cliucks on the Cuntractor's aotivities in order to gain assurancc that this is the case.
- Contractors are to ensure they have processes and procedures in place to ensure that everyone is competent for the role they aretofulfil;further details are shownhelow.

## 2.4.3.1.1. Managers, Designers, Engineers and Supervisor:

- Managers, designers, engineers and supervisors are to hold qualifications relevant to their discipline from an internationally accredited institution and have appropriate experience for the role they are to fulfil. They are to fully understand the health and safety requirements for the Contract and capable of developing health and safety plans and procedures for construction.
- of those they are managing or supervising.

## 2.4.3.1.2. Health and Safety Staff:

- o         n responsibility for health and safety.
- Nominated health and safety staff are to meet the requirements and be appointed in accordance with legislation. Managers shall have a minimum of 10 years and Supervisors a minimur of 5 years relevant experience in the construction industry.All Health and Safety staff shall have attained a recognized Health and Safety qualification and/or affiliation e.g. NEBOSH Diploma,NEBOSH IGC, Tech IOSH). Additionally, H&S Managers and above should hold membership of a discipline recognized professional institution.
- The appointed Health and Safety Manager is not to be removed from the Contract without prior agreementfromEmaar Misr.
- Health andSafetyOfficers shall havenootherduties,eitheron-site oroff-site,other thanhealth and safetyduties,and shall beexclusivetoonesite.
- The ratio of Health and Safety staff to workforce shall be noless than 1:50 i.e.at least oneHealth andSafety Officerforeach50workers or part therefore e.g.2 Safety Officersfor 75workers.
